title: A chat model for Roblox projects
summary:
Roblox-focused chat joins the model list, while image fallbacks and text API diagnostics get some attention.

Added `roblox-rp`, a censored chat model with a system prompt for Roblox development, Lua, and roleplay.

Expanded keyword matching for dating and NSFW prompts, revised referral messages, and added `/redirect/*` handling for referral links and analytics.

Restored Cloudflare SDXL as the image fallback when Cloudflare Flux fails, before trying ComfyUI. `gpt-4o-mini` now uses its primary configuration rather than randomly choosing between two; tunnel restart configuration and text API diagnostics were also added.

highlights.title: Roblox-focused chat
highlights.text: Use `roblox-rp` for Roblox development, Lua, and roleplay in a censored chat model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=roblox-rp).
